name: M3M Route 65
summary: The project, M3M as developer, Sector 65 on Golf Course Extension Road, the 4-acre land area and the ready/operational status are confirmed. Our RERA number GGM/605/337/2022/80 is cited by some portals, but another gives RC/REP/HARERA/GGM/803/535/2024/30, so the sources conflict. Starting prices vary widely (₹54 L–₹90 L against our ₹1 Cr), and sources describe 2 basements + ground + 5 floors, not 4.

checks.web: M3M Route 65 (also written Route65), high-street retail project in Sector 65, Gurgaon

checks.note: Our 'listed as' developer name is the project name, which is cosmetic.

checks.ours: Sector 65, Golf Course Ext. Road, Sector 65, Gurugram, Haryana
checks.web: Sector 65, Golf Course Extension Road, Gurgaon
GGM/605/337/2022/80 (Propzilla, and others per search); RC/REP/HARERA/GGM/803/535/2024/30, dated 27.03.2024 (RealtyPromoo)

checks.web: Ready to move; operational, tenanted and trading since late 2025 (RealtyPromoo)
checks.note: One search snippet claimed the occupancy certificate was rejected. That claim is unconfirmed.

checks.web: Original RERA timeline February 2027, completed late 2025 (RealtyPromoo); 05 July 2027 (search snippet); 2026 (Propzilla)

checks.web: ₹90 L–5.4 Cr (100acress, via search snippet); ₹75 L–10 Cr (RealtyPromoo); ₹68 L onwards (Propzilla); ₹54 L–3.85 Cr (search snippet)
